keyInsights: The village sees what no villager sees. We contribute to a vision we cannot individually possess.
Racing assumes a single destination. Paralleling assumes the journey itself is the point.
The shore is not where the crossing ends. The shore is where the crossing becomes collaborative.
Agreement is when we say the same thing. Convergence is when different instruments point at the same structure.
Seven is not arbitrary. Seven is structural.
